name: extension-paragraph-numbering
description: The paragraph-numbering converter extension applied to a document mixing body prose, an admonition, a list, a sidebar and a table. Proves the extension's effect matches the canonical toolchain — Principle XV names an extension without passing comparison coverage as not done — and that the exclusions hold: only document- and section-level paragraphs carry a number. The theme sets the extension's contributed key to a non-default colour so a regression that stops reading it fails rather than passing silently.
